name: A Straight Answer
summary: The Ashfound have counted the machines on the plaza. Their marshal wants a straight answer.

offer.summary: Marshal Kade of the Ashfound is waiting on the plaza.

warm.summary: You kept the door open. The Ashfound will trade and will not lie.

cold.summary: You sent the marshal away. They do not need to be liked.

joined.summary: You joined the Ashfound. The forge left of the yard gate is open; the Lattice and the Rootched are closed.
